title: per-model-kernel-hints-and-fallbacks-for-llama-mistral-qwen
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Introduce per-model kernel hint table, MQA->GQA compatibility fallbacks, and KV cache compaction heuristics; config flags to opt out for Private deployments.
description: Motivation: some recent production regressions and bench runs showed that a single kernel selection path is suboptimal across model families. This PR adds a lightweight per-model hinting layer and fallback handlers to steer kernel selection, KV-cache compaction, and batching strategies for Llama/Mistral/Qwen families without changing upstream model binaries. Scope: 1) kernel_hint_table and hint API, 2) MQA<->GQA decoding fallbacks for older quantized checkpoints, 3) KV cache compaction heuristics to avoid OOM for long prefix workloads, 4) continuous-batching early-bundle hints for high-concurrency Llama workloads, 5) runtime feature flags and telemetry. Checklist: [x] kernel hint table schema and loader, [x] Llama rotary scale guardrail and batch bundling hint, [x] Mistral attention grouping fast-path, [x] Qwen rotary alignment fix and fallback kernel, [x] KV cache compaction switch with conservative defaults, [x] unit + perf tests, [x] docs/perf notes. Linear: ENG-3789 tracks kernel hint schema; ENG-3812 tracks KV compaction instrumentation. Related: RFC link: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-3789/per-model-kernel-hoisting (internal). Summary of commits: - add kernel_hint_table and schema loader (runtime/kernel_hints.{cpp,h}) - implement per_model_hint API and apply at kernel selection points - add Llama-specific rotary_scale guard and early-bundle hint in batching layer - add Mistral attention grouping fast-path with smaller workspace allocation - add Qwen rotary alignment shim and fallback kernel for odd-dim checkpoints - KV cache: add compaction heuristics and eviction watermark metrics - tests: perf/model_quick_bench.py updates and new microbench harnesses - docs: docs/perf/notes-model-hints.md High-level files changed: runtime/kernel_hints.cpp, runtime/kernel_selector.cpp, runtime/kv_cache.cpp, runtime/batching/continuous_batcher.cpp, models/llama/compat.cpp, models/mistral/attention_group.cpp, models/qwen/rotary_shim.cpp, tests/perf/model_quick_bench.py, docs/perf/notes-model-hints.md Notes on approach: the hint table is a tiny JSON/YAML mapping that ships with model manifests; runtime falls back to existing selection if no hint exists. We purposely keep hint semantics advisory (priority integers + predicates) so platform routing/autotuner can override. KV compaction is conservative: compaction triggers only after a sustained prefix growth > 2x baseline and when available GPU memory is below configurable watermark. MQA/GQA: added a short compatibility shim that remaps per-layer quant dims when we detect mismatch patterns from certain vendor-quantized checkpoints; falls back to slower generic kernel with logging if remap fails. Performance results: measured on internal perf lab (A100, seq_len=2048) — end-to-end median P99 token latency decreased 8-14% for Llama-2-70B workloads with concurrent small requests; Mistral models see 6-9% throughput improvement on long-tok cases due to attention-grouping fast-path; Qwen benefited in token throughput on odd-dim checkpoints with negligible overhead on aligned models. Review conversation summary: "Jordan: overall good, but please make kernel hints opt-outtable for Private installs (security/compliance)." "Maya: added feature flag runtime.config.allow_model_hints=false and documented behavior — responded inline and added test." "Priya: nit on naming of rotary guard variable; suggested clearer telemetry labels — changed to telemetry.label='rotary_scale_guard' for easier dashboarding." "Luca: asked for a safety net if MQA/GQA remap produces silent failures; requested a fatal fallback metric — implemented 'remap_failure_count' counter and an alertable log line." "Jordan (approve): Verified perf runs and telemetry; approved with one follow-up for expanded model matrix." CI checks: ["build: pass", "unit-tests: pass", "integration-perf: pass (flaky test x23 rerun)", "lint: pass", "security-scan: pass"] Post-merge actions: add hint table docs to model onboarding checklist, schedule ENG-3870 (follow-up) to add autosuggested hints from perf lab results, and onboarding note for Private installers to set runtime.config.allow_model_hints=false by default. Migration/compatibility: no breaking changes by default; runtime preserves old behavior when no hints are present. Config flags: runtime.config.model_hint_mode={"off","advisory","enforce"} default="advisory". Observability: new metrics added: kernel_hint_applied_count, kernel_hint_fallback_count, kv_compaction_run_count, remap_failure_count, rotary_scale_guard_hits. Rollout: staged rollout over 2 weeks with canary traffic limited to 5% then 25% then 100%.
